notes.title: Space Routine Live Stream
notes.notes:
Watch us play [b]Space Routine[/b]! 

Feel free to chat, ask questions about the game, or just chill out while we take care of our space kids, the space baby, space job, space groceries, and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37001071/00bf23942860315b9c8971dd9114262ab843548a.jpg[/img]

Space Routine is a space family life simulator set up in a retro sci-fi cartoon universe. The player takes control of the members of each member of the family making them follow their daily routine and tasks like going to work, school, shopping, leisure, and spending time at home.

We will be live Streaming in Steam and our Youtube Channel: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5VN_HKrxc-KUAAJnGKm0tg]MeNic Games Youtube Channel[/url]
